function.name: convo_search
function.description:
Ranked search over ALL LiteHarness conversations on this machine (C:\Projects\LiteTUI\.convos, 400+ convos) — the fleet-wide memory of what every agent has ever discussed, decided or run. Backed by SQLite FTS5 (bm25, user/assistant messages weighted 10x tool output). Default view is ONE ROW PER CONVO ranked by its best match — it answers 'which conversation', use `messages=true` for the flat per-message view.
query: search terms, implicit AND, quoted phrases supported. Verify ground truth before trusting a no-hit: a word absent from every raw transcript genuinely returns nothing (grep for absence is the raw file, not this index).
show: dump one conversation's indexed messages (convo id or unique prefix).
raw: grep the RAW on-disk convo.jsonl with a regex (convo id as `raw`, pattern as `query`) — for confirming what the index holds.
stats: index health — convo/message/char counts by role. The index is incremental and current; no rebuild needed to search.

query.description: search terms (implicit AND); with raw=, a regex pattern instead

show.description: dump one convo's indexed messages (convo id or unique prefix)

raw.description: grep the raw on-disk convo.jsonl for a convo (id or prefix); query becomes the regex

since.description: only convos created within N days

messages.description: flat per-message view instead of one row per convo
